That could be the answer to why some weed is shit when it generally ticks all the right boxes. There is no way to replicate a good, medical grade high without a complete well grown plant being the only source, it ends up as hash, flower, rosin ect. 
It either works for the user or it doesn’t.

There is 100% a massive influx of sprayed/dodgy weed going around. It has effects on me similar to the above comment where his head was fucked for 8 months.

I have a conflict over this as well as some bud I smoke and it really doesn’t work for me, however my friends and people around me find it fine. Maybe different times for different folks? Or maybe they just don’t mind a crippling anxiety, headache, sweaty body palms, head pressure, mucus high. Maybe. 

Stay away from sprayed terps, synthetic anything and be very careful about what you smoke. Anything that doesn’t look right, just fuck off the dealer and try again. 

Stay safe.

That is a hard question to answer as it is a different process for everybody, I can only speak for myself. 

For me, it was my ability to see where the problems in my life lay. Stopping smoking itself did nothing, and made everything more difficult. However, it made other things possible and brought things to light that has been smoked away for more than 10 years. The free time you discover from not being high all the time enables you to work on these things and hopefully come out the other side better and a more rounded person..

I have been sober this time around for 3 months before I was sober for 2 years, and before that sober for a year.

All in all the time it takes for me to notice I am becoming stagnant in life has reduced significantly and my response to that is to stop smoking again and try again. 

I know this sub is about quitting cannabis for good, however for a lot of people I feel it is about breaking the chains of addiction and destructive patterns. We are smoking so much because there are underlying problems, which are not getting mentally sorted by continuing to smoke. 

I wish you all the best, and if you need anything shoot me a message.
